summary: The project has several concentrated risks around a single engineer and a long-running blocker that is already past its due date. Scope is also expanding without estimates.

risks.title: Critical work is concentrated on a single person
risks.evidence: Alice is the only assignee on #29 (critical database migration), #42 (payment blocker), and #55.
risks.recommended_action: Immediately pair or reassign at least one of the high-priority items. Document the database schema knowledge.

risks.title: Payment integration blocked for more than 2 weeks
risks.evidence: Issue #42 has label blocker, was created 20 days ago, due date was 2026-07-25 (already missed).
risks.recommended_action: Escalate to the payment provider or prepare a temporary mock/fallback path.

risks.title: New high-impact feature added without estimate
risks.evidence: Issue #51 created 3 days ago with label unestimated and no assignee.
risks.recommended_action: Run a quick estimation session and decide whether this belongs in the current release.

risks.title: Long-lived quality issue
risks.evidence: Issue #38 (flaky checkout tests) open for 25 days and past due date.
risks.recommended_action: Schedule a focused bug-bash or quarantine the flaky tests.

positive_signals: Active recent work on several issues
trend_explanation: A critical blocker has already missed its deadline and key knowledge remains siloed.
next_steps: Unblock or escalate the payment gateway issue this week
Reduce bus-factor risk on Alice’s critical tasks
Estimate and prioritize (or defer) the new discount engine request
